title: Tola runs Chinese all-comers' record in Beijing (World Athletics report & calendar)
claims: World Athletics lists the 18 October 2026 Bank of China Beijing Marathon as a World Athletics Label Road Races Gold Label event in its calendar.

Tamirat Tola (Ethiopia) won in 2:03:10, a Chinese all-comers' record, improving the previous all-comers' mark of 2:05:35 run by Philemon Kiptoo Kipchumba in Shanghai in 2023 and the Beijing Marathon record of 2:07:06 set by Mathew Kipkoech Kisorio in 2019.
Muktar Edris and Adane Kebede, also Ethiopia, finished in 2:04:34 and 2:05:10, both inside the previous Beijing record.
Anchinalu Dessie (Ethiopia) retained the women's title in 2:20:36 ahead of China's Ciren Cuomu (2:23:48) and Lu Ying (2:24:24).
